source_contract.current_contest: Native raceType/electionType/race title; national HG is House.
source_contract.current_choice_given_prior: Native candidateAnswers.percentage, bound by literal candidateId and party.
source_contract.suppression: Native -1 and null remain unavailable; never reconstructed from other cells.
source_contract.composition_shortfall: Below 98 across four whole-point prior shares exceeds rounding tolerance. Preserve cells and difference from 100; withhold composition-based arithmetic without attributing the residual.
source_contract.special_elections: Native SP uses electionType P with title Senate Special Election; ordinary binary arithmetic withheld pending official scope review.
source_contract.nonunique_major_parties: No forced assignment of independents, multiple same-party candidates or ranked-choice rounds.

sample_and_weighting.shared_study: CNN, NBC and MS NOW tables are not independent samples.
sample_and_weighting.unsuccessful_recontact: Initial choice retained; not universally completed-ballot responses.

limits: Conditional switching among current poll groups is not an original-2024-coalition switching rate or a share of overall election swing.
Prior presidential nonvoting is not validated all-ballot nonparticipation.
No 2026 nonvoter rows; direct population drop-off remains unavailable.
Rounded products are descriptive arithmetic, not design-aware confidence intervals.
Subsets overlap; never add them or allocate state or national estimates to counties or precincts.
Source respondent bases are not effective prior-choice-cell bases.
Office differences can reflect ticket-splitting rather than changed beliefs or causal persuasion.

preliminary_population_extension.required: Qualified official prior coalition total T24, matched current voter total N26, joint prior share q and current conditional p.
preliminary_population_extension.qualification: Not measured staying home: migration, mortality, recall, incomplete reporting and contest-denominator uncertainty remain. Preserve infeasible residuals as diagnostics rather than clamping them.
